skipintro.description: Skip the opening videos and legal screens. Takes effect next time the game starts.
cutsceneskip.description: The skip button skips every cutscene and video, also the ones the game doesn't let you skip. Their last seconds still play, so the story continues just as after watching them.
hideskip.description: Hide the cutscene skip button prompt.
leaderboards.description: Disable global leaderboards to prevent the Hoboken Alleys co-op crash.
checkupdates.description: Checks fusionfix.io for a newer version when the game starts and tells you in the game.
update.hub: Fusion Fix {} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
update.site: Fusion Fix {} is available at fusionfix.io.
subtitlesize.description: Subtitle scale. 1 is the original size.
outlinesize.description: Subtitle outline scale. 1 is the original size.
borderless.description: Remove borders in windowed mode. Select windowed mode in Graphics first.
confinecursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't move to another monitor.
sprintlook.description: Look up and down while sprinting as far as when walking, instead of the camera staying level.
lightsync.description: Logitech lighting effects. Requires Logitech G HUB and supported hardware.
devicechange.description: Prevent device-change notifications from randomly opening the pause menu.
hudaspect.description: Center the HUD within this aspect ratio, capped to the screen width. Auto uses the full screen.
fov.description: Add up to 45 degrees to the gameplay field of view. 0 uses the original FOV.
consolegamma.description: Use the original PC gamma or a console gamma curve.
antialiasing.description: TAA needs DirectX 11 or 9, DLAA and FSR need DirectX 11; all with the game's MSAA off. DLAA and FSR also need FusionFixHub's upscalers.
aasharpness.description: Sharpens the image after TAA, DLAA or FSR. 0 turns it off.
intelchecks.description: Lets Intel graphics use DirectX 10 and 11, which the game otherwise only allows DirectX 9 on.
menu.plugins.description: Settings of Fusion Fix and the other installed plugins.
menu.preset.description: Choose a preset, then select Apply preset. Custom means the settings match no preset.
menu.apply.description: Sets the settings that take part in presets to the chosen preset.
menu.apply.confirm: Select again to confirm. Some changes take effect next time the game starts.
menu.disabled: Not available with the current settings.
menu.savefailed: Could not save the settings file. Changes remain in memory.
